mapper.select: SELECT day.id AS attendance_day_id, day.department_id, day.attendance_date, department.name AS department_name, count(target.member_id) FILTER (WHERE target.is_target) AS target_count, count(record.id) FILTER (WHERE target.is_target AND record.status = 'PRESENT') AS present_count, count(record.id) FILTER (WHERE target.is_target AND record.status = 'LATE') AS late_count, count(record.id) FILTER (WHERE target.is_target AND record.status = 'ABSENT') AS absent_count FROM public.attendance_day AS day JOIN public.department AS department ON department.id = day.department_id LEFT JOIN public.attendance_target AS target ON target.attendance_day_id = day.id LEFT JOIN public.attendance_record AS record ON record.attendance_day_id = target.attendance_day_id AND record.member_id = target.member_id WHERE day.id = #{attendanceDayId} GROUP BY day.id, department.id

SELECT member.id AS member_id, member.name, member.birth, record.status FROM public.attendance_record AS record JOIN public.member AS member ON member.id = record.member_id JOIN public.attendance_target AS target ON target.attendance_day_id = record.attendance_day_id AND target.member_id = record.member_id AND target.is_target WHERE record.attendance_day_id = #{attendanceDayId} AND record.status IN ('LATE', 'ABSENT') ORDER BY lower(member.name), member.name, member.birth NULLS LAST, member.id

SELECT account.id FROM public.account AS account JOIN public.account_department_role AS role_assignment ON role_assignment.account_id = account.id AND role_assignment.department_id = #{departmentId} AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' AND role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN public.account_telegram_connection AS connection ON connection.account_id = account.id WHERE account.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY account.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.attendance_notification_outbox( notification_type, attendance_day_id, department_id, account_id, message_text) VALUES ('ATTENDANCE_DAY_FINALIZED', #{attendanceDayId}, #{departmentId}, #{accountId}, #{messageText}) ON CONFLICT (notification_type, attendance_day_id, account_id) WHERE notification_type = 'ATTENDANCE_DAY_FINALIZED' DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT expires_at FROM public.telegram_link_token WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.telegram_link_token(account_id, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{tokenHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt})
INSERT INTO public.telegram_webhook_update(update_id, received_at) VALUES (#{updateId}, #{receivedAt}) ON CONFLICT (update_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT token.id, token.account_id, token.expires_at FROM public.telegram_link_token AS token JOIN public.account AS account ON account.id = token.account_id AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE token.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND token.consumed_at IS NULL AND token.revoked_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF token
mapper.update: UPDATE public.telegram_link_token SET consumed_at = #{consumedAt} WHERE id = #{tokenId} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.account_telegram_connection( account_id, chat_id, telegram_user_id, linked_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{chatId}, #{telegramUserId}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET chat_id = EXCLUDED.chat_id, telegram_user_id = EXCLUDED.telegram_user_id, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE public.attendance_notification_outbox SET status = 'CANCELED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, lease_until = NULL WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY')
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM public.attendance_notification_outbox WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND notification_type = 'TELEGRAM_CONNECTION_TEST' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT outbox.id, outbox.account_id, connection.chat_id, outbox.message_text, outbox.attempt_count FROM public.attendance_notification_outbox AS outbox JOIN public.account AS account ON account.id = outbox.account_id AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN public.account_telegram_connection AS connection ON connection.account_id = account.id WHERE outbox.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND outbox.next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (outbox.department_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.account_department_role AS role_assignment WHERE role_assignment.account_id = account.id AND role_assignment.department_id = outbox.department_id AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' AND role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL)) ORDER BY outbox.next_attempt_at, outbox.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.attendance_notification_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY')

UPDATE public.attendance_notification_outbox SET status = 'SENT', telegram_message_id = #{telegramMessageId}, sent_at = #{sentAt}, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, updated_at = #{sentAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE public.attendance_notification_outbox SET status = 'RETRY', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE public.attendance_notification_outbox AS outbox SET status = 'CANCELED', lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE outbox.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.account AS account JOIN public.account_telegram_connection AS connection ON connection.account_id = account.id WHERE account.id = outbox.account_id AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (outbox.department_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.account_department_role AS role_assignment WHERE role_assignment.account_id = account.id AND role_assignment.department_id = outbox.department_id AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' AND role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL)))
